intro: One list for all your Secret Santas. Your Santa sees it, and you'll never see what's been claimed.
count: {count, plural, =0 {No wishes yet} one {# wish} other {# wishes}}
hide-hint: Want a group not to see a wish? Hide it in that group, on its “My wishlist” tab.

import.label: Paste a link to a shop
import.hint: Add as many as you like: any of them will do.
import.done: Link added with what we found. Check the wish before you save.
import.failed: We couldn't read that page. We kept the link; fill in the rest yourself.
import.bot-wall: {shop} doesn't let us read its pages. We kept the link and guessed a title from it; fill in the rest yourself.
import.blocked: That address can't be used. Try a link to a shop or web page.

form.title: Wish
form.kind-surpriseMe-hint: Describe what you like; your Santa picks something.
form.kind-donation-hint: No gift, a donation to a cause. Add a link to it.

group.title: My wishlist in this group
group.intro: Everything on your wishlist shows here, unless you hide it from this group.
group.visibility-description: Switch a wish off to hide it from this group only. Your other groups still see it.

giftee.title: {name}'s wishlist
giftee.intro: You're {name}'s Santa. Call dibs on a wish so nobody else buys it too.
giftee.taken-hint: Someone else is getting this one.

got-gift.title: Got your gift?
got-gift.private: Only you see this. {name} never does; on gift day the presenter only knows how many gifts to unwrap.
got-gift.not-yet: Got something for {name}? Mark it and the gift reminders stop.
got-gift.marked: {count, plural, one {You've got # gift} other {You've got # gifts}}
got-gift.dialog-description: Tick the wishes you got (that calls Dibs! too) and add anything that isn't on the list. Untick everything to undo.

errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
errors.taken: Someone just called dibs on this one.
errors.rate-limited: That's a lot at once. Try again in a few minutes.
